items.title: Einspruch (objection) against the 2025 Einkommensteuerbescheid
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter states a separate posting date ('Abgesandt am 20.11.2026'), which governs delivery fiction instead of the printed letter date. Posting day = Friday 20.11.2026. Letters from a German authority posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 are deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO as amended by PostModG), counting calendar days from (but not including) the posting day: 21.11 (Sat) = day1, 22.11 (Sun) = day2, 23.11 (Mon) = day3, 24.11 (Tue) = day4. Since this is a tax office, if the 4th day were a Saturday, Sunday or holiday it would move to the next working day (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO) — but 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday, a normal working day, so delivery is deemed on 24.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period under § 355 Abs. 1 AO then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the delivery day itself is not counted, and the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026 (a Thursday). 24 December is explicitly a working day under German deadline rules, and it is not a public holiday in Bremen, so the deadline does not shift. Final day to file the Einspruch: 24.12.2026.
